scope: First classic uncompressed scalar UInt16 tiled TIFF profile, C++/Python and both ImGui hosts
implementation_review: Append-only ordinal 24 and strict version 10 records preserve all prior format values, defaults and producers.
Complete tile tag sets, homogeneous positive geometry, exact payload byte counts and overlap/budget checks precede pixel reads or callbacks.
Logical row segments preserve endian order and ignore edge padding; fixed 64x64 output tiles have deterministic zero padding and exact preflight bounds.
Provider samples are validated before serialization; streaming failures retain exclusive staging and atomic publication boundaries.
Explicit flat tiled import reserves its temporary copy and revalidates held identity before publication.
Shared controls invalidate estimates/consent; replay remains inert. Actual source/installed hosts preserve exact XY/XZ/YZ words.
commercial_scope: Original C++ tile IO; previously reviewed dependencies and versions reused; no non-commercial component or Qt/JVM runtime introduced.
remaining: Pinned ImageJ 1.54r cannot open tiled TIFFs; libtiff is the IO oracle
Only scalar UInt16 uncompressed classic TIFF tiles; other tile samples/codecs, BigTIFF and broader metadata remain open
Actual ImGui event streams and CPU readbacks, without an OS-input/GPU equivalence claim
The partial format registry still needs reconciliation with the implemented profiles and real variant/fixture/run links; this review does not declare G080 or matching-release acceptance.
